steps.note: login.jhtml 302s to havanaone/login.htm; the QR canvas is the page's only canvas, rendered ~0.8s after doc start (qrCode/generate.do fires at ~0.17s) — no tab click needed, it sits beside the password/SMS form. Direct URL skips the 9.8s www.taobao.com front
cropped to the QR element — what the human scans (淘宝 App 扫一扫). qrCode/query.do polls scan state from ~0.8s automatically
on scan+confirm havana navigates off login.taobao.com (mid-login hops stay on that host, so this fires on the real landing). Cookie lands on .taobao.com — any taobao session can import it afterwards
logged-in landing evidence; session stays alive after the flow — session_id on the receipt is the export handle (GET /session/:id/cookies, /storage)
